# GARBO

> GARBO is the premier news platform and gallery for AI-generated art, digital design, and metaverse fashion.

GARBO covers the intersection of artificial intelligence and creative fields, featuring artist portfolios, editorial analysis of AI's role in art, and digital fashion collaborations. The platform serves as both a news source and showcase for emerging digital artists exploring AI-assisted creation.

## Key Topics

- AI art
- Digital art
- AI-generated design
- Metaverse fashion
- Web3
- Digital creativity
- Emerging artists
- House of Meta
- Portfolio projects
- Art technology
- AI in creative fields
- Digital art gallery
- Avant-garde design
- NFTs
- Creative ethics

## Core Pages

- [GARBO | AI and Digital Art News](https://www.gar.bo): Garbo homepage: premiere news provider for AI art, digital design, and meta-inspired fashion
- [About Us | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/info): Garbo about page: mission statement on AI art news, design, and editorial independence
- [Blog | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/blog): Garbo blog hub featuring AI art, Web3, NFTs, and digital artist profiles and guides

## Featured Collections & Collaborations

- [Collections | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/poetxhouseofmeta): Poet x House of Meta collaboration showcasing digital fashion and metaverse design collections

## Artist Portfolios

- [Barrows | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/portfolio-collections/my-portfolio/blown-up): Barrows portfolio project: colorful digital designs showcased via House of Meta venue
- [Doughty | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/portfolio-collections/my-portfolio/mashup): Swiss AI designer Doughty's portfolio: interpretive digital creations exploring purpose and design
- [Marshall | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/portfolio-collections/my-portfolio/tectonic): Marshall's unconventional design portfolio: roadway and color-inspired shape-focused artwork
- [Miquella | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/portfolio-collections/my-portfolio/figura): Miquella's AI art portfolio: realism-focused pieces influenced by Italian cultural context
- [Palleo | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/portfolio-collections/my-portfolio/facade): Spanish artist Palleo's digital portfolio: merging traditional studio art with digital design freedom
- [Charat | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/portfolio-collections/my-portfolio/tubes): Charat's architectural design-inspired AI portfolio: exploring shape, form, and digital composition
- [Kelsh | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/portfolio-collections/my-portfolio/moon): Emerging designer Kelsh's portfolio: unconventional found-object-inspired digital art pieces
- [Rouge | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/portfolio-collections/my-portfolio/arches): Rouge's AI art project: color-focused work exploring red palettes and creative interpretation

## Editorial & Analysis

- [Art's Unending Journey | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/evolution-of-art-embracing-evolution-despite-controversies): Article exploring art's evolution and AI's role in creative fields despite ongoing controversies
- [Features | GARBO](https://www.gar.bo/hypocrisy-of-art-condemning-ai): Feature article examining artistic originality debates and AI's impact on creative ethics
